record.intent: Evaluate a reversible acquisition-setting control without changing installed software policy.
record.title: Ordinary channel-limiter sensitivity at fixed source frequency
acceptance: The fixed975MHz OFF-to250M-toOFF fifteen-record acquisition or exact bounded failure is sealed with transport, condition-specific validity and restoration evidence.
The frozen AC RMS and OFF return criteria yield a reproducible setting-associated conclusion with alias, source-stability and software-policy limits.
